description: This file defines a generic Java interface named GenericService with methods for common CRUD operations, including create, update, delete, getAll, and findById.

classes.name: GenericService
classes.description: A generic service interface providing standard CRUD operations for a specified entity type T and key type K.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Method to create a new entity of type T.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Method to update an existing entity of type T.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Method to delete an entity of type T.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Method to retrieve a list of all entities of type T.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Method to find an entity of type T by its key of type K.
